surface_leg_subsample.note: lattice subsample of the surface leg; the dot leg is computed on every candidate dot

dot_gate_literal_note: the stated rule (> 70 % of dots within 3 px) applied without the lift condition; reported because broad continuous-surface comparators can satisfy it by coverage alone

dot_leg_scope.note: a comparator whose positives already lie within 3 px of >= 70 % of the scored footprint (continuous probability maps, uniform lattices) would flag a random candidate as a duplicate; those rasters are compared on the surface leg
